findings.message: Sentence 'These lotus feet are holy, and they make holy whoever comes to them' / 'जो इनके पास आए उसे भी पवित्र कर देते हैं' is given in the site's own voice and reads close to a promise to the reader. The text's word pāvana does mean 'purifying' (mw-pavana, p. 623,2), so this is a gloss and not an invented benefit claim. Still, 'whoever comes to them' goes a little beyond the word. A human should decide whether to tie it explicitly to the word's meaning.
findings.suggested_fix: EN: 'The word calls these lotus feet both holy in themselves and purifying.' HI: 'शब्द के अनुसार ये चरण-कमल स्वयं पवित्र हैं और पवित्र करने वाले भी।'
